ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_exp_weighted_cost_gap_inverse_margin_clamped
ir.intuition: Preserves exponential weighting by inverse margin and cost gap, adding clamping for numeric stability to prevent infinity values during training.
ir.pseudocode:
eps=1e-6
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
cost_gap = batch['cost_gap']
weight = batch.get('weight', ones_like(lpw))
margin = lpw - lpl
abs_margin = abs(margin)
inverse_margin = 1 / (abs_margin + eps)
exp_loss = exp(-clamp(margin, max=50)) * abs(cost_gap)
loss = exp_loss * inverse_margin * weight
return mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-6
    lpw = batch["log_prob_w"]
    lpl = batch["log_prob_l"]
    cost_gap = batch["cost_gap"]
    weight = batch.get("weight", ops.ones_like(lpw))
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    abs_margin = ops.abs(margin)
    inverse_margin = ops.div(ops.ones_like(abs_margin), ops.add(abs_margin, eps))
    clamped_margin = ops.clamp(margin, max=50.0)
    neg_clamped_margin = ops.neg(clamped_margin)
    exp_loss = ops.mul(ops.exp(neg_clamped_margin), ops.abs(cost_gap))
    loss = ops.mul(ops.mul(exp_loss, inverse_margin), weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
